items.title: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) Dropped, So What Is Drawing Attention Now?
items.summary: Short sellers recently reduced their bearish bets on Marathon Petroleum (MPC), with short interest dropping to 6.38 million shares after the refiner reported Q3 2026 earnings per share of $26.93 against a $25.95 estimate. Marathon Petroleum’s share price has retreated recently, with a 7-day return down 7.38% and a 30-day move down 26.43%.
